visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up, high-angle shot of a pair of metallic silver over-ear headphones resting on a light wood surface. Circular digital screens integrated into the outer ear cups are active, displaying bright, animated portraits of women in anime-style graphics. (2) A young man with short dark hair and a black collared shirt holds the headphones in a brightly lit studio. He gestures towards the screens with his right index finger, talking with an animated and cheerful facial expression. (3) The man demonstrates the touch-screen functionality, swiping through several different visual outputs including a digital cat, and a "DO NOT DISTURB" warning label with yellow hazard stripes. (4) Close-up shot of the man wearing the headphones to show the fit; the glowing screens are visible on the sides of his head as he turns his profile to the camera. (5) A macro shot focuses on one ear cup's screen, showing a functional user interface with a battery percentage icon at 27%, brightness sliders, and playback buttons like play/pause and skip. (6) The man uses his thumb to pry the circular screen unit off the headphone; it detaches magnetically, revealing the internal structure of the ear cup. (7) He shows a dedicated black charging case that holds the two detached circular screen modules, demonstrating their independent charging capability. (8) The headphones are seen again on a vertical stand in a cozy indoor environment with a small plant and a lit candle in the background, showing the brand logo 'Jamo' on the inner frame. (9) The man concludes by holding the headphones up to the camera and speaking directly to the viewer, while text overlays indicating the price in USD and TWD appear on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A confident and energetic male voice begins the narration, speaking in Traditional Chinese with high articulation clarity. An upbeat, mid-tempo electronic background track with soft synth pads and a light percussive beat starts playing simultaneously at a comfortable volume. (2) As the narrator describes the screen features, subtle high-frequency digital tapping and swiping sounds are audible, synchronized with the visual UI interaction. The narrator's pitch is dynamic, rising at the ends of sentences to maintain viewer engagement. (3) A distinct mechanical clicking sound occurs when the magnetic screen is removed from the headphones, followed by continued fast-paced narration explaining the charging case. The music remains consistent in the background, providing a cheerful bed for the speech. (4) The narrator lowers his volume slightly while summarizing the pros and cons of the audio quality, before ramping up the energy again for the final price reveal. The track ends with a clean fade-out of both the vocal and music layers.
